title: EMPLOYMENT VERIFICATION CONSENT FORM
text:
EXPLANATORY NOTE FOR THE “EMPLOYMENT VERIFICATION CONSENT”
FORM (IF APPLICABLE)
This form is a supplementary form to the Personality Notes Forms and the Abridged Personality
Notes form.
Who Should Complete this Form?
It only applies to applicants or nominees who have ever worked or are working outside Ghana.
What is Required When Completing the Form?
1. The form must be fully completed, signed and dated by the nominee or applicant who have
ever worked or are currently in employment outside Ghana, either as an intern, support
staff, contract staff or full-time staff.
2. Provide Social Security Number in that foreign country on each completed form.
How Many Forms Must be Completed by Applicants?
1. A form filled must be addressed and filled for each school/institution attended outside
Ghana.
2. The applicant or nominee is only permitted to consolidate his/her employment history for
the same Company on one form if he/she has occupied multiple positions at different times
in the said Company outside Ghana.
NB:
Kindly note that applicants or nominees who are completing the Abridged Personality Notes
form are required to complete this form, purposely to provide only updated employment
history which were obtained outside Ghana, after the NIC had approved them for more than
two years.
